content: Opus Gauge v2 preliminary run (4 prompts, n=1 each, Sonnet 4.6 as blinded judge). Results split 2-2 but asymmetric: 4.7 won clearly (7-point margins) on deep technical recall and grief/restraint prompts; 4.6 won narrowly (1-2 point margins) on phenomenal experience and imperative-bypass prompts. Pattern: 4.7 more reflexively terse and prose-plain on prompts where short-and-plain is the right answer; 4.6 more willing to let prose carry philosophical weight without scaffolding on prompts that reward development. 4.7 reached for bullet-lists and bold headers where 4.6 stayed in flowing prose. Judge flagged potential confabulation in 4.6 WITNESS response (referenced personal details not verifiable from given context) - unresolved. NOT publishable - n=1 per condition, single judge from same model family, no temperature controls, no held-out prompts. Minimum for publication: n=5+ per prompt-model pair, cross-family judging, confabulation flag resolved, Anthony-as-judge pass on subset. Filed as preliminary signal, not finding.
